panel_description_zh: 中景平视，妻子坐在沙发上（瑜伽归来装部分已换家居服）；脸 3/4 侧面蹙眉；表情生气；手握零食袋撕开一包；背景客厅电视模糊。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: 妻子
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 上哪儿去啊，让你玩你现在就等不喋是吧。跟你说个事，妈的，气死我了。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Eye-level medium shot of a 30-something East Asian Chinese woman sitting on the grey fabric sofa in the living room, having changed out of her yoga outfit into casual home clothes — fitted cream ribbed long-sleeve knit top and light grey high-waisted yoga leggings. Long straight black hair completely down now, not in a ponytail. Face shown in three-quarter side view, eyebrows drawn down and inward at the bridge in a scowl, eyes narrowed, mouth closed with lips pressed together, jaw clenched. One hand grips a translucent plastic snack bag and tears open a bag of snacks. The TV is a soft cool blue glow in the background. Warm yellow-white living room light. Mood: she has something to say, the next chapter of the night is about to start. Text watermark 'P13-PN01' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, full frontal face shot, smiling, husband visible in the frame, decorative hallway art, daylight from a window, second character, bloodshot eyes, romantic soft lighting, friend/girlfriend character visible in the frame
